rule.poisonAccepted: Accept repeated driver markers when every measured public path refuses before another execute and preserves stored rows. Ship divergence probes without shipped-source changes.
rule.poisonBound: Reopen a driver-only bound only if a public call reaches repeated execute or appends a second marker. Ship only with first-marker, failed-commit retry and refusal gates passing on every applicable lane; otherwise retain tests and record INCOMPLETE without source.
rule.exclusionAlternative: Keep the default binding byte-identical when the Python data-module alternative passes and a test-only exclusion candidate demonstrates the author-controlled undetected-state cost.
rule.exclusionReopen: Do not ship an exclusion option. If the alternative fails or a candidate requires shipped Python changes, stop and report the evidence.

predictions.driverRepeats: Native CPython adds one marker per extra direct execute, in the same and fresh drivers. Public adopted-session start rejects invalid; restore, resume and submit refuse unrecoverable without rows or traffic on Node and all three browsers, making repeated execute UNREACHABLE.
predictions.firstMarker: Changed-request and removed-call divergence append exactly one compact marker on native, Node, Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
predictions.failedCommit: A failed marker commit leaves the paused row intact; a subsequent direct execute re-detects divergence and commits one marker. Public pending reads of the committed poison add nothing.
predictions.bindingAlternative: Python data-module edits allow resume; JSON edits refuse before replay or traffic. A Python edit changing a journaled request diverges.
predictions.candidate: The test-only candidate satisfies explicit bounded validation and digest properties; an excluded real DSPy state file can be swapped undetected.
predictions.limits: Real models remain unmeasured because no model access is available. DSPy 3.2.1 remains unmeasured because the prior offline overlay failed collection with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'dspy.lm15'.

vocabulary.PASS: Ran through its final assertion successfully.
vocabulary.DIVERGED: Ran with an unchanged assertion that failed; record the first failing message.
vocabulary.NOT RUN: Launch, boot or installation failed; record the error without scenario claims.
vocabulary.EXISTING: An existing unchanged measurement was run again.
vocabulary.UNREACHABLE: The public path refuses before the Worker execute can repeat a marker.
vocabulary.INCOMPLETE: A required gate could not be measured; that executor ships no source.
